notes: Give a truck a label instead of T1. Load › Name This Truck… (or double-click its tab) now has a Label box: up to 10 characters, like “TRL A” or “BOX”. It takes the place of the truck's number everywhere: the tabs, the pack labels and their QR codes, the checklist, the PDF, and ShopCall when you Send Pack Numbers (“TRL A #5” instead of “T1 #5”). Two trucks of a gig can't share a label. The longer name (“Penske 26′”) still shows beside it. Leave the label blank to keep the number. After changing a label, Send Pack Numbers again and reprint the labels.
